flags.why: The example explains the historical name instead of using it to mean Vietnamese.
flags.fix: Ông dịch cuốn sách từ tiếng Hán sang tiếng Nam. = He translated the book from Chinese into Vietnamese.

flags.why: The Southern-dialect meaning is still used today, so the historical tag is misleading.
A learner today is more likely to encounter the Southern-dialect meaning than the historical name for Vietnamese.
The construction 'anh cảm thấy như tiếng sét ái tình' is unnatural because it compares the person directly to the thunderbolt.
flags.fix: Ngay lần đầu gặp cô ấy, anh đã bị tiếng sét ái tình đánh trúng. = He fell in love with her at first sight.
